en.headline: Cardinal Chow invites all parishes to hold masses for Tai Po fire victims on 26 November
en.dek: The Bishop of Hong Kong asked parishes to offer a mass on the first anniversary of the Wang Fuk Court fire that killed 168 people.
body: Cardinal Stephen Chow, Bishop of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong, has invited all parishes to offer a mass on 26 November for those who died in the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po.

In a letter dated 13 November, the cardinal noted that the No. 5 alarm fire occurred on 26 November 2025. He asked that relevant prayer intentions be included in the Prayers of the Faithful at all masses the following Sunday. The Diocesan Liturgy Commission issued suggested intention texts for the deceased, their families, and for charity, truth and justice.

The fire at the Tai Po housing estate burned for more than 43 hours, killed 168 people and left nearly 5,000 residents displaced. Some parishes had already planned memorial masses; reports said police had enquired about details of certain services.
The diocese has previously organised prayers and collections for victims of the fire.

zh.headline: 周守仁樞機籲各堂區11月26日為宏福苑亡者獻彌撒
zh.dek: 天主教香港教區主教周守仁邀請各堂區在大埔宏福苑五級火一周年當日，為168名遇難者奉獻彌撒。
body: 天主教香港教區主教周守仁樞機已致函各堂區主任司鋒，邀請他們在11月26日為大埔宏福苑火災中的亡者奉獻彌撒。
信件日期為11月13日。樞機指出，2025年11月26日宏福苑發生五級火警，並懇請在隨後主日彌撒的信友禱詞中加入相關意向。教區禮儀委員會亦提供了為亡者、家屬以及為慈善、真理與正義祈禱的建議文本。
大埔宏福苑火災燃燒超過43小時，造成168人死亡，近5000名居民流離失所。部分堂區早前已計劃舉行追思彌撒；有報導指警方曾向個別堂區查詢活動詳情。
教區早前已為火災受害者舉行祈禱及籌款。
